findings.summary: Composite mobile inset omitted CAPS while alpha contract requires the full key inventory; inset is now explicitly illustrative and excluded from key inventory/baseline.
Legacy numeric cross-span wording conflicted with the latest confirmed three-column IA; latest IA precedence and current three-column target are now explicit.
Pixel baseline now has manifest schema, paths, generator/comparator entry points, and self-baseline prohibition.
Native touch and Web click surface-dismiss paths now have separate composed proof requirements.
Theme RGB table and selected modifier token consumer are now explicit with red mutations.
Plan metadata now calls the old requirements path historical and keeps the approved IA asset as IA_ASSET.
Keyboard pixel comparison now requires an exact-rgba branch in the existing comparator, with legacy-threshold callers preserved and explicit exact metrics.

notes: Round-1 and round-2 reports are retained as immutable review records; author disposition is in the current design/plan, not a rewritten verdict.
The DESIGN independent-subagent cycle has used its two-round limit; Claude review is the next external review and is not represented as complete here.
Claude review cannot substitute for the independent subagent review.
